# Camp Resource: Classic Nuka Cola Mystery Machine

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 11, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d09387ac4d864f49a1f16b7c39b19e6b~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

This marvelous Classic Nuka-Cola Machine holds every Nuka-Cola variety you could ever want! But which one will you get?

Be warned, there is a 5 minute restocking period before you will be able to quench your thirst again.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Classic Nuka Cola Mystery Machine__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6081db291dad44dbb45c2f6ed52316a5~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

- Nuka-Cherry: 3.63%
- Nuka-Cola: 40.50%
- Nuka-Cola Cranberry: 1.50%
- Nuka-Cola Dark: 1.50%
- Nuka-Cola Grape: 3.63%
- Nuka-Cola Orange: 3.63%
- Nuka-Cola Quantum: 1.50%
- Nuka-Cola Twist: 40.50%
- Nuka-Cola Wild: 3.63%

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Americana Nuka Cola Mystery Machine, Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

N/A - Refer to the cooldown period

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - Pristine Nuka-Cola Machine - 500 Atoms

Atom Shop - Nuka-Cola Factory Bundle - 1500 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

5 min (300 seconds) cooldown period.

**Lockable**

15 caps per use

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
